documentation.description: Estimate the recall and cost of approximate kNN search configurations on a bbq_disk dense_vector field against a more thorough baseline. The bounded default baseline uses 20% visit with rescore_vector.oversample 100; exact full-precision search must be requested explicitly and is limited to 100 million vector-by-query comparisons. Each knn_settings entry reports mean recall of the baseline's top-k, not of relevance judgments, plus included/excluded query counts and cost totals. A query is excluded from mean recall when the candidate finds a document scoring above the baseline's lowest top-k score. A baseline returning fewer than k hits fails that query because recall@k is undefined. A rescore_window_capped flag reports when search_size multiplied by oversample exceeds the 10,000-vector rescore limit. All configurations run against one point-in-time.

index.description: A comma-separated list of index names to search

ignore_unavailable.description: Whether specified concrete indices should be ignored when unavailable (missing or closed)

allow_no_indices.description: Whether to allow (1) wildcard index expressions that match no indices and (2) requests where the final resolved set is empty.

expand_wildcards.description: Whether to expand wildcard expression to concrete indices that are open, closed or both.

wait_for_completion.description: Whether to wait for the evaluation to complete. If false, return a task identifier and store the completed response for retrieval through the task API.

body.description: The kNN evaluation definition: a bbq_disk dense_vector field; k from 1 to 1000; exactly one of queries or sample; an optional baseline (default visit_percentage:20 and rescore_vector.oversample:100; exact:true is gated by search.allow_expensive_queries); 1 to 32 unique knn_settings entries (visit_percentage, num_candidates up to 10000 and rescore_vector); and max_queries_per_batch from 1 to 100 (default 1). Explicit visit_percentage:0 selects DiskBBQ's automatic visit calculation.
